_readme: Append-only log of manual / browser executions. Add a new entry per execution (never edit old ones). sync_tracker.py applies the newest entry per test case to the workbook and records every status change in 'Status History'. status: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT RUN. PASS/FAIL need concrete evidence; BLOCKED needs the reason in failure_details.
